method: Resumed re-check (the first run, 2026-09-27, opened 14 Sketchfab listings and was stopped before writing verdicts; its saved copies under [session scratch file] were reused, not re-fetched). Sketchfab: Data API (no key) + viewer metadata endpoint (source-file names and sizes, texture names and sizes, download and store state) + server-rendered model page (licence and NoAI rows) + comments and user-profile APIs, via [session scratch file] (the first run's script, retargeted). Originality was judged from text only: descriptions, source and texture file names, exact face/vertex counts and archive sizes compared across uploads, comments and uploader profiles. No model file, texture, thumbnail, preview or screenshot was opened, viewed or downloaded, so body, wheels and cabin were NOT seen for any model and are judged from text. BlenderKit (now Blendkit) search API and its licence pages; Blend Swap site search. CGTrader (HTTP 202 empty WAF challenge) and TurboSquid (403 DataDome) were each tried once and not worked around. WebSearch was not used (0 of 5).
scope: Every Mazda RX-7 FD3S entry in docs/asset-shopping-list.md (usable table, needs-your-call table, avoid list, and leads in its notes), every lead in the RX-7 item of docs/research/asset-candidates-2026-09-26.json (including its searchNotes), the 14 listings in docs/research-notes/part3a.md section 4, the re-upload clusters flagged there, and new searches: Sketchfab Data API license=by and license=cc0 for interior, engine-bay, dashboard, trim-name and year queries [session scratch file] on top of the first run's 21-query sweep [session scratch file] Ddiaz Design's RX-7 uploads; Blendkit search (rx7, rx-7, fd3s, mazda rx); Blend Swap search (rx7, rx-7, fd3s, mazda).
verdicts: usable = licence allowed by CLAUDE.md rule 5 and no sign it is a rip or re-upload (still needs the owner to look at the body in the viewer); needs-your-call = allowed licence but a fit or originality question only the owner can settle; avoid = licence not allowed, game rip or re-upload, or not a stock FD.

blendkit.answer: No for a plain GLB on GitHub Pages. The Royalty Free licence allows games only if the models "can't be extracted by the users in an easy way".
